findings.claim: _promoted_object_v2 injects pixel_id alongside custom_conversion_id without custom_event_type and executes an unbound lookup on source_ref.
findings.evidence: Lines 662-667 fetch 'fonte = publicos.fonte(str(medida.source_ref))' and emit {'pixel_id': fonte, 'custom_conversion_id': ...}. Meta's API contract explicitly requires that if pixel_id is specified in promoted_object, custom_event_type must be provided. Furthermore, when an adset optimizes on a custom conversion without an explicit source_ref, publicos.py line 146 skips resolution, leading line 662 to call publicos.fonte('None') and crash.
findings.proposal: When medida.custom_conversion_ref is present, omit the source_ref lookup and return only {'custom_conversion_id': publicos.conversao(medida.custom_conversion_ref)}. Reserve pixel_id and custom_event_type exclusively for standard event optimization.
findings.test: Compile an adset with custom_conversion_ref set and source_ref=None; assert that publicos.fonte is never invoked and promoted_object contains only custom_conversion_id.

findings.claim: is_adset_budget_sharing_enabled is transmitted in CBO campaign payloads, while campaign bid_strategy is omitted when ABO uses budget sharing.
findings.evidence: Line 601 sends 'is_adset_budget_sharing_enabled' unconditionally. Meta's Marketing API specifies that is_adset_budget_sharing_enabled applies only to campaigns not using a campaign budget (ABO). Lines 606-612 misinterpret Meta error 100/4005 as a CBO requirement; in reality, enabling ad set budget sharing on an ABO campaign requires campaign-level bid_strategy, which lines 604-612 omit whenever orcamento is None.
findings.proposal: Conditionally omit is_adset_budget_sharing_enabled when orcamento is not None (CBO). For ABO (orcamento is None), if is_adset_budget_sharing_enabled is True, attach plano.receita.bid_strategy to the campaign payload.
findings.test: Compile both a CBO plan (confirming is_adset_budget_sharing_enabled is omitted) and an ABO plan with is_adset_budget_sharing_enabled=True (confirming campanha contains bid_strategy).

findings.claim: bloquear('INSIGHTS_DIARIOS_AUSENTES_PARCIAIS_OU_INCOMPATIVEIS') is invoked without return, allowing attribution and totalization to execute on invalid daily slices.
findings.evidence: In financeiro.py, terminal guards return the blocker helper (lines 210, 212, 216, 224, 363). At line 239, bloquear is called without return, so execution falls through to line 240, sets estado='COM_SNAPSHOT', executes GAM queries, and computes atr.totalizar(linhas), violating the comment at lines 343-344 requiring that incomplete/divergent slices be rejected.
findings.test: Run financial attribution on an insight payload failing completo_meta checks; verify execution short-circuits immediately without querying GAM tables or invoking totalizar.

sources.claim: If pixel_id is provided in promoted_object, custom_event_type must be provided; custom_conversion_id specifies a custom conversion.
is_adset_budget_sharing_enabled allows ad sets to share budget for campaigns not using a campaign budget (ABO).

limitations: Whether plano.is_adset_budget_sharing_enabled defaults to False or can be True in ABO depends on omitted contrato_v2 validators.
Upstream validation guaranteeing that receita.standard_event is non-null when custom_conversion_ref is None was omitted from the excerpt.
The internal behavior of atr.totalizar and whether it raises on completo=False cannot be verified without the omitted modulo atr.
review.summary: Identified three defects: invalid promoted_object construction bundling pixel_id and custom_conversion_id without custom_event_type alongside unsafe source_ref resolution, inverted CBO/ABO handling for ad set budget sharing and campaign bid_strategy, and a missing return statement that permits incomplete Meta insights to proceed through attribution totalization.
